comment: The cases of the Rust core and of the bindings generated from it (docs/spec/json-contract.md#core, RQ-026 to RQ-035), one group per member of packages/rust/interface.json in the case convention of binding G-5: the keys are the parameter names of the member, and a method takes its receiver from the keys of a factory of the value (text, units, literal, value or members; no key is null). bytes are {"hex": ...}, a float that JSON cannot write is {"float": ...}, and a json_value is {"kind", "value"}. A failure is raises: its kind, its category (F-3) and, where the rule fixes them, properties. A result of a case that does not raise is result, raw (the token of the made value), number_literal, size, text or ok. bits is the big-endian hex of the binary64 float of value. faults names the fault injection points that a case arms before its call (G-5, X-1). A group whose name ends in .parsed takes its value from the JSON text json, which the default parse reads: it is a rule corpus of the Rust test of the core (a parsed token, an object that no factory of a scalar makes), not linked in the cases of the interface contract.
